description: The literal segment '0' is no longer coerced to numeric 0, so dot-notation 'a.0' and bracket-notation 'a[0]' resolve to different keys
productionImpact: Any path written with dot-notation for index zero (e.g. `items.0`) will read from or write to the string key `'0'` instead of array index `0`, so `getProperty(arr, 'items.0')` silently returns `undefined` while `getProperty(arr, 'items[0]')` returns the correct element. Schema migrations and JSON-path consumers that normalize paths in either style will silently diverge.
